# SoundSegment

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Audio` · record struct

```csharp
public readonly record struct SoundSegment
```

Describes a named sub-range of a [`Audio.Sound`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Sound.md) as a `(offset, duration)` pair. Mirrors [`Graphics.TextureRegion`](TextureRegion.md) for audio: a non-owning view over an underlying framework resource that callers can pass to a voice factory in place of a whole [`Audio.Sound`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Sound.md).

## Remarks

A `SoundSegment` has no lifetime of its own and is not `IDisposable`; the underlying [`Audio.Sound`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Sound.md) is owned by whoever loaded it (typically the [`SoundBank`](SoundBank.md) that produced this segment, or content service callers for a whole-sound segment).

The framework's [`AudioService.CreateVoice`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/AudioService.md#createvoice) bakes the segment into the voice at construction time, so playback remains allocation-free on every platform.

A default segment has no sound and can't be played: test for one with `segment == default`.
